context_for_next_testing_agent: Digital PR Platform Phases 5, 8, 9, 10 fully tested. Phase 5 (Relationship CRM) supports interaction logging (email, call, meeting, pitch, note types), contact history with stats, and top contacts by relationship score. Phase 8 (Press Kit Management) supports asset library with multiple types (logo, product_image, company_fact_sheet, video), press kit creation with share URLs. Phase 9 (Alerts & Monitoring) supports alert types (brand_mention, keyword, competitor, journalist), triggers with sentiment tracking, and stats dashboard. Phase 10 (Pipeline View) shows Kanban board with 9 stages (prospect through declined), conversion rate stats, and contact stage movement with interaction logging. All 11 journalist contacts are in the database with pipeline stages.

mocked_apis.note: All APIs are MongoDB-backed with real data persistence.
